highlight.title: From the Church, Into the World
highlight.text: Not leaving the church behind, but carrying faith, calling and mission into the crowds, industries, cities and nations.

iaaIntro.tagline:
Connecting Kingdom Leaders.
Transforming Society. Blessing the Nations.

blocks.title: Core Positioning
paragraphs: The Impact Asia Alliance (IAA) is concerned not only with spiritual renewal and building within the church, but with **how believers, equipped by local churches, step into every sphere of the world and respond to the calling entrusted to them by God**.

IAA does not aim to build a new denomination, church system, or ministry structure. Instead, it **respects and connects existing churches, organizations and professional leaders**, enabling Kingdom resources scattered across different nations, cultures and fields to see one another, complete one another, and collaborate together.

Therefore, IAA's position is not to "lead people away from the church," but to **help believer-leaders equipped by the church step into society with mature faith and professional competence** — bearing witness to the Gospel, serving communities, transforming culture and blessing the nations in the real world.

detail.intro: IAA is more than another international conference — it is a global platform that gathers and connects Kingdom leaders, fostering cross-sector collaboration, dialogue and exchange.
detail.quote: Impact Asia Alliance is more than another international conference. It is a global platform that gathers and connects Kingdom leaders, fostering cross-sector dialogue, learning and collaboration.

blocks.title: Our Origin
paragraphs: Many Christians are shepherded, equipped and built up within the church, yet are **not always clear on how to carry their faith into the workplace, industry, culture and public life**.

At the same time, God has raised up many leaders around the world who are faithfully at work in business, education, technology, media, healthcare, culture, sports, indigenous communities and mission fields — yet **lack a platform where they can meet across boundaries, learn from one another, and collaborate**.

IAA exists to meet this need: **so that the church and the world are no longer separated, spiritual life and professional practice no longer operate in isolation, and one person's calling can enter into a larger Kingdom collaboration network**.

blocks.title: What We Believe
paragraphs: The church as the foundation, the world as the mission field — five core convictions that sustain IAA's mission.

points.title: 01 The Church Is the Foundation
points.desc: The local church is the foundation for believers' spiritual growth, equipping in truth, community building, and sending. **IAA does not replace the church, but walks alongside it**.

points.title: 02 The World Is the Mission Field
points.desc: Business, technology, education, culture, media, healthcare, public affairs, sports and every people group **are all vital mission fields for living out faith and serving people**.

points.title: 03 Every Calling Matters
points.desc: Pastoral ministry is not the only full-time calling. **God also raises up leaders in every industry, making professional skill, resources and influence vessels for blessing the world**.

points.title: 04 Influence Flows from Life and Truth
points.desc: What IAA pursues is not fame, power or scale, but **the lasting influence that flows from the life of Christ, the truth of Scripture, and servant leadership**.

points.title: 05 Collaboration over Competition
points.desc: Kingdom work is not about building separate territories, but about **completing one another across different gifts, cultures and ministries to accomplish a greater mission together**.

detail.quote: We believe that when churches faithfully equip believers, and believer-leaders courageously enter the world, every industry and field can become an important mission field for witnessing the Gospel, serving society, and blessing the nations.

blocks.title: IAA's Mission
paragraphs: Connector, Companion, Collaborator, Catalyst, Impact Center — the five roles IAA carries.

detail.intro: IAA's mission is to become a **connector, companion, collaborator and impact center** for a shared mission.

points.title: Connector
points.desc: Identifying and gathering leaders raised up by God in different fields around the world, **fostering relational connections across nations, churches, cultures, generations and professions**.

points.title: Companion
points.desc: Not only meeting at the summit, but supporting one another through calling, challenge and practice — **building trusted, lasting Kingdom partnerships**.

points.title: Collaborator
points.desc: Facilitating concrete collaboration between churches, organizations, businesses and professional leaders, so **resources, experience and capability can jointly respond to the world's needs**.

points.title: Catalyst
points.desc: Recognizing new work already underway, providing a platform, visibility and strategic exchange so **promising initiatives can be amplified, replicated and extended**.

points.title: Impact Center
points.desc: Integrating content, media, research, talent and international networks to **continually drive influence from faith into social practice**.

detail.quote: IAA connects Kingdom leaders through international summits, thematic forums, leadership exchange, media outreach, education and collaborative action — turning calling into practice, and individual influence into shared influence.

blocks.title: Leaders IAA Gathers
paragraphs: From church and mission to business, technology, education, media, healthcare, sports and global mission fields — Kingdom leaders across eight spheres.

detail.intro: IAA's audience is not limited to church pastors, but includes **all Christian leaders who step from the church into every sphere of the world to carry out their calling**. Pastors play a vital role as equippers, senders and companions.

points.title: Church & Missions
points.desc: Pastors, mission leaders, cross-cultural missionaries, church networks and gospel organizations

points.title: Business & Entrepreneurship
points.desc: Entrepreneurs, CEOs, executives, social enterprises and young founders

points.title: Technology & AI
points.desc: Tech leaders, engineers, researchers, and workers in AI and the semiconductor industry

points.title: Education & the Next Generation
points.desc: Principals, teachers, children's and youth workers, education innovators

points.title: Media & Creative Culture
points.desc: Media professionals, publishers, film and TV, artists, designers and content creators

points.title: Healthcare & Social Care
points.desc: Physicians, healthcare leaders, nonprofit organizations and social service workers

points.title: Sports & Public Life
points.desc: Athletes, coaches, sports missionaries and public affairs leaders

points.title: Ethnic Communities & Global Mission Fields
points.desc: Indigenous peoples, ethnic minorities, and ministry leaders serving Africa, islands, remote regions and unreached peoples

detail.quoteLabel: What We Value Is Not Just a Title
detail.quote: IAA looks for leaders with a foundation of faith, public concern, professional competence, a spirit of collaboration and cross-cultural vision. They may not stand on a stage, yet they are carrying out their calling in their own post; they may not lead a large organization, yet they may be starting something important.

blocks.title: Impact Fields IAA Focuses On
paragraphs: From the Gospel entering society to global compassion and missions — eight impact fields IAA focuses on.

points.title: 1. The Gospel Entering Society
points.desc: **Bringing faith into families, workplaces, cities and public life**, including social gospel initiatives such as "From Doubt to Faith" and "Men Are Warriors."

points.title: 2. FTT & PEACE
points.desc: Connecting global Great Commission resources to **advance church planting, leadership equipping, poverty relief, healthcare and next-generation education**.

points.title: 3. Bible Reading Movement
points.desc: Encouraging individuals, families, churches and the next generation to return to Scripture, **building lives and governance rooted in truth**.

points.title: 4. Next-Generation & Youth Innovation
points.desc: **Developing children, youth, Sunday school leaders and young entrepreneurial leaders** to face the AI generation and future society.

points.title: 5. Technology & the Future of Humanity
points.desc: Fostering dialogue between technology, AI, semiconductors and faith ethics, so **technology serves humanity rather than replacing human dignity and purpose**.

points.title: 6. Culture, Media & Sports
points.desc: Engaging people through story, art, media, creativity and sports to **build gospel-valued cultural influence**.

points.title: 7. Indigenous Peoples & Ethnic Reconciliation
points.desc: **Respecting and preserving ethnic cultures**, fostering connections among tribal leaders, historical reconciliation and cross-ethnic collaboration.

points.title: 8. Global Compassion & Missions
points.desc: Including "Hearing the Heartbeat of Africa," "The Lost Pearl," "Bringing Love Back to Cambodia," and **support for ethnic minority missions**.

blocks.title: What the Annual Summit Does
paragraphs: See, Listen, Discern, Connect, Collaborate, Send — the six key movements of the summit.

detail.intro: The IAA Global Summit is not a one-way lecture event, but an annual gathering built around "**seeing, connecting, discerning, collaborating and sending**."

points.title: See
points.desc: Seeing the new work **God is doing across different nations, ethnic groups and fields**.

points.title: Listen
points.desc: Listening to the real experience, challenges and insight of frontline leaders, **rather than mere ministry presentations**.

points.title: Discern
points.desc: Jointly discerning **the direction of the times, society's needs, and the Kingdom's response**.

points.title: Connect
points.desc: Enabling previously unacquainted leaders to build relationships, **opening the door to cross-sector collaboration**.

points.title: Collaborate
points.desc: Moving from dialogue into concrete action — **enabling shared resources, joint projects and long-term partnerships**.

points.title: Send
points.desc: **Returning to one's own city and mission field with new vision, relationships and purpose**.

detail.quoteLabel: The Question the Summit Answers Together
detail.quote: What is God doing in the world today? How can we join His work together, each in our own field?

blocks.title: IAA's Principles of Collaboration
paragraphs: Christ-centered, respecting the local church — seven principles that run through everything IAA does.

points.title: 01 Christ-Centered
points.desc: A shared faith is the foundation of collaboration; **influence must return to the life and truth of Christ**.

points.title: 02 Respecting the Local Church
points.desc: **No cross-sector initiative is intended to weaken or replace the local church**.

points.title: 03 Respecting Each Calling
points.desc: Partners are never asked to give up their existing name, organization or mission — **instead, we work together toward shared goals**.

points.title: 04 Crossing Boundaries Without Losing Foundation
points.desc: Courageously entering different cultures and professional fields **while maintaining clear faith values**.

points.title: 05 Collaboration Creates Multiplication
points.desc: **Shifting from competing for resources to sharing them, from working alone to achieving together**.

points.title: 06 From Exchange to Action
points.desc: Every forum and gathering should, as much as possible, **lead to further connection, projects or concrete action**.

points.title: 07 Measuring Impact by Service
points.desc: True influence is not measured by visibility alone, but by **whether people are helped, society is blessed, and the Gospel is made visible**.

detail.quoteLabel: IAA Does Not Replace — It Completes
detail.quote: IAA does not replace the local church, mission organizations, or professional associations, nor does it fold partners into a single organizational system. IAA builds an open, faith-rooted international platform for connection, so different groups can keep their own identity while collaborating on a shared mission.

blocks.title: Outcomes We Expect
paragraphs: Building **a trusted network of Kingdom leaders across nations, cultures and fields**.
Discovering and supporting **emerging ministries, leaders and initiatives**.
Facilitating **collaboration among churches, organizations, businesses, education and media**.
Making Asia's experience and testimony visible to the world, and **bringing the world's resources into Asia**.
Developing **next-generation leaders equipped to face AI, technology, culture and global change**.
Extending the annual summit into **a year-round collaboration platform and impact center**.
Enabling more Christians to step out from the church and **live out a public witness of the Gospel in their own field**.

blocks.title: Long-Term Vision
paragraphs: IAA aspires to become a Kingdom impact platform that starts in Asia and connects the world — one that does not treat large-scale events as an end goal, but as a means toward **building long-term relationships, developing leaders, facilitating collaboration and supporting action**.

We long to see believer-leaders equipped by the local church carry out their calling across every sphere of the world, and people from different nations, generations and professions complete one another in shared faith — **so that individual gifts become a shared blessing**.

detail.quote: From Asia to the nations. From the church to the world. From calling to influence.
